messages.text-stats.directory.summary: Count words, bytes, and lines in a pinned file version.
messages.text-stats.empty.waiting-detail: Counts the text version pinned as “Before” in Materials. Pin again to refresh; disk edits don’t overwrite a pinned version.
messages.text-stats.empty.waiting: Pin a file version to see its word, byte, and line counts
messages.text-stats.empty.unavailable: The pinned file version is no longer available
messages.text-stats.empty.recapture: Capture it again or choose another input in Sources
messages.text-stats.help.title: Text Stats
messages.text-stats.help.what: Computes word counts, paragraph counts, and structural stats for a fixed text deliverable in your project.
messages.text-stats.help.example-1: Save a Pages doc as a fixed version, then inspect its length and structure here
messages.text-stats.help.example-2: Compare word counts across two frozen revisions
messages.text-stats.help.scope: Purely local and read-only — no network calls, no model cost, and never edits your document.
messages.text-stats.help.advanced: Requires a fixed text deliverable from Pages or Deliverables; never silently swaps versions.
